slides.line: sometimes staying up late isn't about the phone...
it's the only part of the day nobody needs anything from you.
so you steal hours from tomorrow to feel like today was yours.
the scrolling isn't the reward. the quiet is.
then the alarm goes off and tomorrow sends the bill.
it was never a willpower problem. the phone is just always there.

so i gave my phone
the bedtime instead
keep the quiet. lose the scroll.
